decisions.reason: The page records staging load tests, CPU, memory and GC observations, plus production monitoring data. It reports 3,400 messages over 10 minutes, but defines no approved performance target, representative workload, or acceptance criterion. Preserve the measurements as operational evidence, not intended behavior. Referenced dashboard images are absent from the retained export.
